title: vc_grow_seg_from_seed: keep an explicit seed with a zero coordinate
body:
`vc_grow_seg_from_seed` decides whether `--seed` gave a seed with

```cpp
} else if (!use_old_args && origin[0] != 0 && origin[1] != 0 && origin[2] != 0) {
```

(`volume-cartographer/apps/src/vc_grow_seg_from_seed.cpp` line 550 on main at f4570bfa). A seed with any coordinate at 0, for example `-s 0 3936 830`, fails that test and the run falls through to `random_seed`: it grows from a point elsewhere in the volume, prints nothing about the seed it was given, and exits 0, so a script sees a normal run.

The test now asks for any nonzero coordinate. It moves to `apps/src/GrowSeedMode.hpp`, header only like `RenderPrefetch.hpp`, so that the new doctest `test_grow_seed_mode` checks the code the tool runs. A seed of `0 0 0` is still read as no seed, since `origin` starts at zero; when one was given on the command line the run now says so in one log line before it picks a random seed.

### Test

`test_grow_seed_mode` passes on this branch. With main's `&&` put back in `GrowSeedMode.hpp`, 4 of its checks fail, the four seeds with one or two coordinates at zero.

```
cmake --build build --target test_grow_seed_mode && (cd build && ctest -R test_grow_seed_mode --output-on-failure)
```

Built and run from the commit itself in a detached worktree, not from a working tree; only the two targets this PR touches were built (`test_grow_seed_mode`, `vc_grow_seg_from_seed`), not the whole suite.

### Before and after

Both binaries built in the same build directory over the same libraries; before is main's `vc_grow_seg_from_seed.cpp`, after is this branch. PHerc1447 surface prediction, 20 generations, `VC_GROWPATCH_RNG_SEED=20260923`, one thread. Mode and seed are read from the output's `meta.json`.

| seed given | build | exit code | mode in meta.json | seed in meta.json |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 3936 830 | main | 0 | `random_seed` | 5005, 1870, 16068 |
| 0 3936 830 | this branch | 0 | `explicit_seed` | 0, 3936, 830 |
| 2464 2411 12410 | main | 0 | `explicit_seed` | 2464, 2411, 12410 |
| 2464 2411 12410 | this branch | 0 | `explicit_seed` | 2464, 2411, 12410 |
| 0 0 0 | main | 0 | `random_seed` | 4903, 6670, 19595 |
| 0 0 0 | this branch | 0 | `random_seed` | 4319, 3186, 5132 |

On the last row the branch also logs `seed [0, 0, 0] discarded: 0 0 0 reads as no seed, picking a random seed`; the random seed differs between the two runs because the pick uses `rand()` after `srand(clock())` (line 369), not `VC_GROWPATCH_RNG_SEED`.

This fix was the first commit of #1885, which is closed; the rest of that PR is withdrawn and the reference ray occlusion cost it touched is described in #1914.
